name: change-plan-runner
description: Orchestrate an owner-approved workspace plan as sequential, resumable agent batches with evidence gates and optional Git verification.

MAX_BATCHES.prompt: Maximum batches accepted in one plan.

NEXT_BATCH_DELAY_SECONDS.prompt: Delay before dispatching the next approved agent batch.

GIT_MODE.prompt: Git policy: auto, required, or disabled.

REQUIRE_CLEAN_TREE.prompt: When Git is enabled, require a clean worktree at batch boundaries.

REQUIRE_COMMIT.prompt: When Git is enabled, require every batch to produce a distinct commit.

REQUIRE_PUSH.prompt: When Git is enabled, require each completed batch commit on its upstream branch.
